messages:
priya_csm: kicking off Verdigris Systems onboarding. Goal: pilot hosted chat + retrieval, decision on Dedicated after pilot. Proposed kickoff Wed 10/16 2pm PT. Agenda: intros, success criteria, access (SSO/API keys), sanitized data handoff, infra sizing, security questionnaire, procurement/PO timeline, enablement plan, risks. Whos in?

aisha_cs: Im in. Ill run enablement + feedback capture. Note: Verdigris requested a 1-hour enablement for power users.

verdigris_pm: PM + infra lead can make Wed 2pm. Well upload a sanitized dataset (ndjson) and list of top 12 prompts by Tue EOD. Procurement asks for PO estimate early.

marc_se: Ill own SSO + ingestion. Need sample, IP ranges, and a short list of core API calls the app uses. Also please confirm retention/PII policy for logs.

tony_eng: Ill scope Dedicated sizing & smoke tests. Also will add a quick perf checklist: p50, p95, and token-cost estimate.

natalie_successops: Proposed success metrics (short):
- Pilot demo accepted by PM + CS lead
- Top 6 user journeys pass staging tests (happy path + 2 edge cases)
- p50 latency <300ms under pilot load or documented tradeoff
- Security questionnaire answered and signed off by security team
- Procurement PO/estimate in place before Week 3
- Runbook + escalation path documented

priya_csm: Timeline suggestion:
Week 0: Kickoff + discovery + security questionnaire sent
Week 1: Access setup (SSO, API keys), sample upload, security review start
Week 2: Integration + enablement session 1, perf benching
Week 3: Pilot run (limited traffic) + feedback capture, procurement PO due
Week 4: Demo + go/no-go + handoff plan

verdigris_pm: Legal will review retention policy; can confirm within 72h. Procurement aiming to get PO within 10 business days if estimate is ready.

marc_se: Quick request for Verdigris: share example curl with auth header so we can test earlier. e.g.:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TEST_KEY>" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

tony_eng: For Dedicated bench Ill start with 1x and 2x card-equivalents and share numbers in the kickoff doc. Also note: infra needs allowlist 48h before staging tests.

natalie_successops: Feedback plan: 3-question pulse immediately after pilot + 15-min stakeholder interview. Will draft survey and attach to doc.

priya_csm: Action items from thread:
- aisha_cs: create kickoff doc + send invite (owner)
- verdigris_pm: upload sanitized sample + prompts + PO contact (owner)
- marc_se: SSO checklist + ingestion plan (owner)
- tony_eng: Dedicated bench + smoke test template (owner)
- natalie_successops: success criteria + feedback survey (owner)
- priya_csm: own risk register & schedule 30/60 health checks (owner)

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Wed Oct 16 2:00pm PT "Verdigris Systems: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff"  invites sent. Link: https://meet.redwood/verdigris-kickoff

aisha_cs: Ill add the enablement outline to the doc and propose dates for the 1-hour session.

verdigris_pm: uploading sample now. Legal contact: legal@verdigris.example.

marc_se: noted on allowlist; adding 48h constraint to calendar invite.

priya_csm: Great  if procurement or security windows look tight, flag here so we can re-prioritize. See you Wed.
